facts.fact: 雪后男主闭门三日埋头读本地民俗，追问 Firefleet 的危险、Benn 为何警告 Arthur 离开、Caroline 出了什么事
facts.anchor: He spent the next three days indoors, immersed in local folklore

facts.fact: 男主又找到 Benn 博士两本书《Ley Lines and Dragon Veins》与《Telluric Currents and Ley Lines》，作者试图证明地底能量的存在及其对人类的影响
facts.anchor: two more books by Dr Micheal Benn: Ley Lines and Dragon Veins

facts.fact: 书中写道：出殡路线沿地线而行，这或许解释这些地点的闹鬼史；人类技术把古老力量放大到指数级
facts.anchor: It has long been believed that the coffin routes across these moors followed the paths of ley lines

facts.fact: 雪已三英寸厚，盖住石楠与蕨草丛、车道、小路与花园；世界一夜重造，荒原重获贞洁
facts.anchor: The snow was already three inches deep, covering the tussocks of heather and fern

facts.fact: 男主涌起一阵明亮狂喜与释然，像童年雪天；但想到网球与鸟，笑意随即褪去
facts.anchor: He felt a sudden, luminous burst of exhilaration and relief

facts.fact: Arthur 2019-09-29 日记：网球是显现，它们不属于此地正如我们不属于此地，它们召来土地守护者处置入侵者，鸟落下，他当时在读 THE LIGHTNING CHASERS
facts.anchor: The tennis balls are a manifestation

facts.fact: 男主第一次读日记时把 walkers 当成背包客，如今重读怀疑是更险恶的东西，想到铁塔而战栗
facts.anchor: He’d assumed Arthur was talking about backpackers

facts.fact: Arthur 2019-12-21 最后一条日记：雷暴夹雪，天空踩着闪电的高跷走过，线路全断，walkers 来了，他想躺下歇会儿；此后日记全是空白
facts.anchor: I think I’ll lie down for a while
